subject: Quanta Health — Immersion sprint planning (API & console enable)
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <alex@quantahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@quantahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Planning an immersion sprint for Quanta Health (API + Console)

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Quanta's product and platform teams want to move from discovery to a hands-on immersion sprint so they can be self-sufficient on Redwood for production workloads. High level ask: a focused enablement track that covers both console admin flows and API integration (keys, batching, KV cache, and a short troubleshooting runbook).

What we were thinking:
- 2–3 day immersion sprint (mix of lecture + labs)
- US & EU stakeholders — prefer sessions that can accommodate West Coast mornings and late EU afternoons
- ~12 total attendees (product, infra, SRE, security) — attached a draft attendee list

Preferred weeks: week of Mar 24 or week of Apr 7. Do you have a proposed agenda and a short checklist of prerequisites (sandbox access, SSO, sample traffic)?

We can be flexible on format (three 2-hour blocks vs two half-days). If helpful, Priya can loop in our Okta admin.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

— Alex
Quanta Health | Lead Platform Engineer

Subject: Re: Planning an immersion sprint for Quanta Health (API + Console)

Hi Alex —

Great to hear Quanta wants an immersion sprint. We can support both console admin and API deep dives. Attached is a first-pass enablement agenda that maps sessions to outcomes (admin flows, API keys, batching/quantization guidance, KV cache walkthrough, live lab).

Quick thoughts:
- Format: our recommendation is three focused 2-hour blocks across consecutive days. That preserves lab continuity and keeps attendee fatigue down.
- Time windows: for cross-region attendance we suggest 9:00–11:00 PT / 17:00–19:00 CET for the EU participants.
- Prereqs: sandbox projects created, Okta test app, a short sample payloads doc, and one engineer with infra access for the lab.

Ben — can you confirm capacity on the enablement team for week-of Mar 24?
Sofia — I tagged you for the runbook and SSO checklist; can you own the prerequisites doc?

Alex — I dropped the agenda in this Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQuantaEnablement (Redwood: Quanta Enablement). If Mar 24 looks tight we can target Apr 7.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt

Alex / Hannah —

Quick SSO / provisioning checklist so we can get Quanta into the sandbox ahead of time:
1) Okta test app + demo service account for Redwood (service@quantahealth.com)
2) SPF/DKIM checklist for inbound mail if we need to send invites programmatically
3) IP allowlist for sandbox if you run restricted networking
4) List of attendees with roles (dev / sre / security) — prefer CSV

If you can provide the Okta metadata and a sample attendee CSV by EOD Thu (Mar 6) we'll aim to have the sandbox and accounts ready the week of Mar 17 for a smoke test.

On another note: do you plan to include any procurement/contract questions during the sprint? If so we should loop in Marissa for alignment on any special access or billing notes.

Thanks Hannah, Ben, Sofia —

This looks good. We can do Mar 24–26 as three consecutive 2-hour blocks (9:00–11:00 PT). Priya confirmed our Okta admin will provide SAML metadata and a test account by Wednesday (Mar 5). Attached our SSO config and a lightly redacted attendee CSV.

Notes / asks:
- We'll keep load minimal for the first run — primarily functional integration, then a quick throughput check on day 3. Ben, we'll flag if we need reserved capacity.
- Please include a short troubleshooting playbook in the agenda (what to do if KV cache desyncs / token spike).

If that works, can we lock the calendar and send invites this week? Happy to do a 15-minute kickoff call tomorrow (Mar 4) to finalize runbook owners.

— Alex
